SELECT e.id, e.employee_no, e.real_name, e.phone, e.position, e.employment_type, e.hire_date, e.resign_date, e.status, e.is_active, e.last_login_at, e.created_at, e.updated_at FROM employee e WHERE e.deleted_at IS NULL
AND e.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{realName}, '%')
AND e.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{phone}, '%')
AND e.status = #{status}
ORDER BY e.created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM employee WHERE phone = #{phone} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM employee WHERE employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND deleted_at IS NULL
